title: Redraw Salma's book pictures with the under-cap and long sleeves
detail: Salma's fringe shows in the book pictures bint / friends / nashit (print pp 4, 13, 15; story s03/s10), and her forearm is bare on p15, which contradicts the site art and the deck's "Modest clothing on every child". Redraw with $HIJAB + NEG "hair, fringe, bangs", long sleeves, a curious (not worried) face, and Noori beside the children rather than on Salma's head. Do it one GPU job at a time, then run web-art.sh and print-book.sh again before the Lulu proof.
ceo_note: RULING recorded (islamic-studies-advisor): not a veto, but redraw before Lulu and the owners' meeting. It is the one finding that can cost trust in the room (step 1).

title: Make every parent CTA readable in all six themes
detail: Page rules beat .btn .en, so the English line of the parent CTA, and on Andalus the whole button, falls to 1.35–3.81:1 (hub, 404, mockups 01/05). Change kids.css to .btn.btn .en { color: inherit }, use .parents a:not(.btn) on Andalus, delete mosaic line 82, then rerun the rendered-contrast scan (every span ≥ 4.5).
ceo_note: Six roles found the same issue. Parents cannot read their one action (step 5), and it is a one-line fix.

title: Let the quiz retry after a hint so every child ends with full stars
detail: KS.quiz draws an empty star for each wrong answer, locks the question and shows "You got 2 of 5", so the child sees lost stars. Change it to shake + hint + try again, award the star once the answer is found, and end with «أَحْسَنْتُمْ! كُلُّ النُّجُومِ لَكُمْ».
ceo_note: Breaks the standing ruling of no punishment; a child must feel safe when wrong (child test 4). Small change in one shared file.

title: Teach the بِنْتٌ / أُمٌّ / شَمْسٌ fence by pointing, not by heart
detail: Book p15 «نَحْفَظُهَا فِي قُلُوبِنَا», deck slide 12 «نَحْفَظُهَا حِفْظًا» and the article's "we learn these by heart" name memorising as the method. Replace them with «هَيَّا نُشِيرُ وَنَقُولُ: هَذِهِ بِنْتٌ، هَذِهِ أُمٌّ، هَذِهِ شَمْسٌ!» and the open-empty-hands «بِلَا صَدَفَةٍ» gesture.
ceo_note: Our own page contradicts the vision line, interaction not memorisation (step 4). The fix is text only.

title: Say the ة rule holds "usually" in every recap
detail: The recaps in the book (p17), story slide 13 and the article state «ة تَجْعَلُ الْكَلِمَةَ مُؤَنَّثَةً» as absolute, right after teaching بِنْتٌ / أُمٌّ / شَمْسٌ. Add «فِي الْغَالِبِ» on screen now and re-record the two clips later.
ceo_note: Correct Arabic comes second only to safety (step 2), and the screen text fix is small. The audio waits for credits (see the re-record item).

title: Praise girls as girls: بَطَلٌ / بَطَلَةٌ on the certificate, أَحْسَنْتُمْ on screen
detail: A lesson about masculine and feminine praises every child as a boy («أَحْسَنْتَ يَا بَطَلُ», «شَهَادَةُ بَطَلِ الصَّدَفَةِ»). Give the certificate a box to tick, «أَنَا بَطَلٌ ☐ · أَنَا بَطَلَةٌ ☐», and use «أَحْسَنْتُمْ» (or أَحْسَنْتَ / أَحْسَنْتِ) in kids.js and the article end.
ceo_note: Every girl should feel respected (step 1), and choosing the box is itself the lesson. Text only.

title: Rename the "magic" ة to the "secret" ة
detail: Article §3 «سِحْرُ التَّاءِ», story slide 8 «الصَّدَفَةُ السِّحْرِيَّةُ» and the hub's "magic ة" praise سِحْر, which careful families avoid. Use «سِرُّ التَّاءِ» / «الصَّدَفَةُ الْعَجِيبَةُ» and, in English, "the secret of ة".
ceo_note: Parent trust and adab (steps 1 and 5). The deck already says «سِرٌّ», so this is text only and makes the series consistent.

title: Live the morals in the story: the shell gift, helping, الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
title_ar: تَفَضَّلِي يَا سَلْمَى! · شُكْرًا، جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
detail: Only the salam and the sandcastle model akhlaq, yet mockup 06 promises "manners woven into every lesson". Add text only: Noori gives Salma the shell («تَفَضَّلِي» → «شُكْرًا يَا نُورِي! جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا»), «نَتَعَاوَنُ» on the sandcastle and «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ» at the end, mirrored in the story. Only then add the honest deck line "What children practise: salam, sharing, thanking", and have the topic-book skill ask "which value?" first.
ceo_note: Moved up from my provisional 'next' (log 2026-10-25): the book text is being touched for the Salma reprint anyway, and the pitch and mockup claims must be true before the owners see them. Re-recording the touched pages waits for credits.

title: Mark every English caption lang="en"
detail: Screen readers read the .en captions with the Arabic voice (hub 37, article 86, story 49 … with no lang). Add one line to the kids.js init (.en:not([lang]) → lang=en) and put lang="en" in the book template and build.py.
ceo_note: A WCAG AA failure on every page. A one-line fix in the shared system gives parents the biggest screen-reader win (step 3, cheapest win).

title: Make a listen tap always answer, even with no Arabic voice
detail: KS.speak returns silently when the device has no Arabic voice, so on the article and the mockups the child taps and nothing happens. Always toggle .is-speaking and play KS.sfx('pop'), and add the clip-first hook (audio/words/<key>.mp3, then speechSynthesis) now, so the word clips work the day they land.
ceo_note: A child whose tap does nothing is blocked (step 3). The code part is small and needs no credits; the clips themselves are a 'next' item.

title: Add «دَوْرُكَ!» say-it-back moments, and a salam reply button
detail: On screen the child never says Arabic (child test 6 fails in the story, article and web book). Add one small KS helper: Noori models the line, shows «دَوْرُكَ! قُلْ: …», waits about 3 s and models it again (no microphone, no grading). Use it on story slides 3/5/6/9 and once per article section, plus a «وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ» reply button on story slide 2.
ceo_note: Top of 'next': the biggest vision gap (speaking), with no new tech. Not 'now' only because it is new interaction code that needs a QA pass.

title: Record ~30 Fusha word clips for every tap-to-hear word
detail: The article (19 cards + quiz) and the mockups' word of the day use the robotic device voice, which often drops case endings. Render about 30 ElevenLabs Sarah clips (full sentences, never a lone letter) to audio/words/ with an index.json word → file map that KS.speak reads, then run qa-audio.py.
ceo_note: Owner go-ahead needed for the ElevenLabs credits. It is the input children hear most (step 4), and the 'now' hook makes it plug in with no code.

title: Answer parents' next questions on the mockups: fee, phone, class size, no Arabic at home
detail: No mockup mentions cost, help for homes without Arabic, the adab promise, class size or sitting in on the trial, and the mailto-only CTA dead-ends on phones without Mail. Add placeholder-marked lines: "Fees: $___ a month · sibling discount · first class free", "No Arabic at home? You can still help", "Adab every week…", "Small classes (max 10) · parents welcome at the trial", and a tel:/WhatsApp link beside the button.
ceo_note: Owner answers needed: the fee and sibling policy, a real phone/WhatsApp number, the class-size cap, and whether parents may sit in on the trial. The copy can ship with placeholders now; the real values come from the owners.

title: Build the "What the team suggests next" slide from this file, then push
detail: The BRIEF queues a searchable, filterable final slide in pitch/index.html that renders claudeteam/suggestions.jsonl (build.py inlines it; over http it is fetched). HEAD is not yet pushed, so Pages cannot fetch the file. Push only when the user asks.
ceo_note: Already queued by the BRIEF as the next step after this consolidation, so the owners see the list.

title: Fix the narration scripts and re-record the touched clips in one batch
detail: The story p11 clip skips هَذَا and the sentence step that the screen shows; the p13 and book bye clips need «فِي الْغَالِبِ»; the book p10 Egyptian says «الله، حلوة قوي!» (→ «ما شاء الله»); the lived-value pages change. Update the transcripts, re-record only those clips, and normalise to −1 dBTP.
ceo_note: Needs the same ElevenLabs credits as the word clips; batch it with them so we spend once.

title: Fix the book text, then rebuild the print files once before the proof
detail: In the same rebuild as the Salma redraw: drop the answer-giving red ة on exercise pp 22/25/27; «فِي آخِرِ كَلِمَةِ «سَمَكَةٌ»» (p21); vocalise the Fusha target words in the Egyptian captions; "This is a sun"; "read the whole story in one sitting" (p3); lay out the certificate stars 6 + 5; "grades 1–2" on the back cover; draw the «←» arrow as SVG (no Type 3 LucidaGrande).
ceo_note: Each fix is small, but a reprint is not. Bundle them into the single print-book.sh run after the 'now' book changes, so we print once.

title: Order one Lulu proof copy and scan every QR from paper
detail: Colours, Arabic shaping and the 48 QR codes have never been checked on paper. Order one proof (≈ $8–15 + shipping) after the redraw and the book-text rebuild, and scan every code with a phone.
ceo_note: Owner go-ahead for the small print cost. It is the most convincing object for the owners, but only after the book is right.

title: Tell the owners what the child does, in plain words with full vowels
detail: The deck's idea slide never says what a child does; the name/book slides leave «شَاطِئُ الضَّاد», «هِلَال»… unvocalised; the hub mockup cards use design jargon ("bento grid… offset shadows"). Add "Children use Arabic from the first minute: they point, act, choose, write and say it back", vocalise the names, and rewrite the cards plainly ("Big colourful tiles, like a playground").
ceo_note: The owners judge by vowels and by the children, not by design words. Cheap and seen in the meeting.

title: Put a do-something moment in the first minute of the story and the article
detail: Story slides 1–7 are 2–3 minutes of listening before the first choice, and the article has no movement. Turn story slide 6 into "find it" («أَيْنَ السَّمَكَةُ؟», tap the right figure, with shake + hint), and add «قُمْ وَأَشِرْ إِلَى الْبَابِ: هَذَا بَابٌ!» to article §1.
ceo_note: Child test 1 ('what do I do?'). Reuses figures that are already there.

title: End every lesson with a "show a grown-up" card and a clear way on
detail: The story ends on a slide with no home task and no way out. Add one shared end card: big Noori, three pictures («هَذَا قِطٌّ · هَذِهِ قِطَّةٌ · هَذِهِ شَمْسٌ») with a listen button for the child to perform, one English line for parents ("Tonight: point at 3 things and say هَذَا / هَذِهِ"), and a next / hub button.
ceo_note: Moves Arabic into the home without the parent needing Fusha (parent test 4). One component, three pages.

title: Tidy the classroom deck's teacher notes
detail: In presentation.html: «وَالصَّفُّ يُرَدِّدُ» (slide 2); «بِإِصْبَعٍ وَاحِدَةٍ» (slide 15); a calm-down cue before writing on slide 16 («اجْلِسُوا… نَتَنَفَّسُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ»); "pages 18–28" (slide 18); and an optional closing «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، تَعَلَّمْنَا الْيَوْمَ…» with «اللَّهِ» vocalised.
ceo_note: The deck is our best piece. These are five small note edits that give the teacher less to fix.

title: Call them هَذَا-words and هَذِهِ-words, not "boy words" and "girl words"
detail: Story slide 1 and deck slide 3 notes say boys'/girls' words; the metaphor breaks on كِتَابٌ and شَمْسٌ and undercuts the fence. Say "هَذَا-words and هَذِهِ-words" (or blue/coral words).
ceo_note: Correct meaning before labels. Text only.

title: Make parent links at least 44 px tall
detail: The hub lesson-book file links are 27 px tall and the footer links 15–21 px. Give them the .chip style: inline-flex, min-height 44px.
ceo_note: Parents on phones. Several roles found it, and it is one CSS rule.

title: Stop the floating theme/mute buttons covering the last lines
detail: At 390 px the FABs cover the bottom text (guide, 404), and a child can mis-tap them while scrolling. Add body { padding-bottom: 88px } in kids.css.
ceo_note: Raised by three roles; a one-line fix.

title: Name each listen button after its word
detail: The 19 article picture buttons are all «اِسْتَمِعْ — Listen». Build the aria-label from the word: «اِسْتَمِعْ: قِطَّةٌ — Listen: cat».
ceo_note: Small a11y win in the auto-wiring.

title: Mark Arabic lang="ar" on English pages and give book images Arabic-first alt text
detail: The guide (27) and the pitch (28) have Arabic without lang="ar"; 6 of 16 book alts are English only. Wrap them via the .ar span in build.py and put the page's Arabic line first in the book template alt.
ceo_note: Completes the 'now' lang fix; template-level, so it needs one pass.

title: Let the ة glow and the book's breathe play three times, not forever
detail: article.html:72 and story.html:113 glow infinitely, and .breathe loops on every book story picture. Use glow … 3, and keep .breathe on the cover only.
ceo_note: Motion must have a job (standing ruling); WCAG 2.2.2.

title: Fix the guide's writing-pad snippet to the full three steps
detail: guide.html 702–703 still shows data-model="ة|هَذِهِ", the incomplete pad that REVIEW #2 fixed, and the copy-paste template will bring it back. Change it to ة|هَذَا|هَذِهِ plus the sentence-station snippet.
ceo_note: Prevents a known regression in lesson 2.

title: Lighten the owners' deck and the hub on phones
detail: The pitch is 4.7 MB on a phone (PNG screenshots) and the hub is 4.97 MB / 139 requests because of six iframes. Write the pitch images as WebP q80 (saves about 2 MB), and show the og card image instead of the iframe below 700 px.
ceo_note: The owners will open it from a WhatsApp link. Cheap.

title: Add one release sweep command with the rendered-contrast scan
detail: Put this review's Playwright loop into tools/sweep.cjs, outside the site: errors, 404s, scroll, targets under 56 px, rendered contrast, the autoplay hook and reduced motion. It prints one before/after table and caught what the token and link checks missed.
ceo_note: Three roles proposed it. It stops the CTA class of bug coming back; it is a tool, not a site feature.

title: Do one real iPad + VoiceOver pass on the story and the book
detail: Nothing has been checked on a real device yet: VoiceOver reading fully vocalised Arabic, the Pencil, Switch Control. Spend 30 minutes on an iPad and log what VoiceOver says for «هَذِهِ سَمَكَةٌ».
ceo_note: This is the last unverified part of the child path, and it costs half an hour.

title: One "For parents" page with the trial booking
detail: Make one placeholder-marked parents.html (or trial.html): when, where, cost, who teaches, a Saturday, the adab promise, "no Arabic at home is fine", and a short parent-only form that opens a pre-filled email/WhatsApp (no backend, no child data). Point every CTA at it.
ceo_note: This is the page parents will forward to family (parent test 5). It needs the same owner answers as the mockup copy item, and stays simple: no backend.

title: Give KG families something: a «point and say» cut of the story
detail: The mockups advertise a KG class, but everything is grade 1–2 with grammar words. Hide story slides 7/8/10/12 behind ?kg: 6 slides, the same art, no مُذَكَّرٌ / مُؤَنَّثٌ, one tap per slide, recorded voice and a sticker. A KG letters-and-sounds book can follow.
ceo_note: Real gap, but 'finish before starting': it depends on the recorded word clips and the echo. Top of 'later'.

title: Make the web book's circle and match pages tappable
detail: On an iPad only the writing pad works; circle, match, fill and adjective are static images. Reuse KS.quiz options with retry on the circle and match pages.
ceo_note: Useful at home, but print is the book's main form. Do it with the games.

title: Pick one form of هَيَّا نَقُولُ / نَكْتُبُ for the series
detail: Both the indicative and the jussive are acceptable. The language expert recommends the indicative everywhere, the simpler form for teachers.
ceo_note: Style only. Apply it when the pages are next touched.

title: Decide Noori's beak: keep the house style or redraw toward the seagull beak
detail: The beak reads as a duck bill rather than the charter's small candy-corn seagull beak, but it is consistent everywhere. Either accept it and update the eye-check list, or apply the logo-c6 recipe in the next redraw round. Don't redraw only for this.
ceo_note: Owner decision. It costs nothing to decide; a redraw would be large, so ride the next art round.

title: Keep at most one ambient loop in the chosen theme
detail: The Pacific drift and float, the Mosaic spin and the Mihrab float are fine as mockup mood. Once the owners pick a theme, keep at most one loop.
ceo_note: Waits on the owners' theme choice; keep it simple.

title: Decide whether the 12 MB of logo masters stay in git
detail: logos/img/v2/hi/ (24 PNG, 12 MB) is referenced by no page. Keep it if the owners want print-ready logos; otherwise git-ignore it like tries/.
ceo_note: Owner call, tied to the logo choice.

title: Move the hard-coded hex values to tokens and mark the fill-only tokens
detail: 12 hex values in article.html and a few in other pages break the 'no hex in page CSS' rule. Add a comment that --masc / --fem are fill-only (text uses --masc-text / --fem-text).
ceo_note: Housekeeping with no visible failure today. Do it when each page is next touched.

title: Clean the cut-out halo on level-1.webp
detail: A white halo shows around the open book on transparent backgrounds. Use a tighter threshold or a 2 px erode in make-web.py.
ceo_note: Visible only on some backgrounds. Cheap, but not urgent.

title: Group the web book's grown-up controls under «لِلْكِبَارِ»
detail: «English» and «auto-flip» sit beside the child's 56 px voice toggle. Put them in a <details> grown-ups menu like Print / PDF.
ceo_note: They already meet the 44 px rule; it is a mis-tap risk, not a blocker.

title: Add two more practice lines to the worksheet trace pages
detail: About a third of Letter/A4 pp 1–3 is blank above the footer. Add 2 empty lines at the same 26 mm pitch (check the series look with ui-designer).
ceo_note: Teachers like it. Bundle it with the next worksheet rebuild.

title: Write dry-run book drafts to print/draft/
detail: The noori-two -DRAFT PDFs sit beside the real noori-shell files and both show in the Lulu file picker. One path change in print-book.sh.
ceo_note: A small safety change. Do it before the second book is printed.

title: Next topic book: هُوَ وَهِيَ, with a value chosen first
detail: This is the natural sequel, using the same nouns, characters and art through the topic-book skill. Its first page recalls four of today's words; it adds تَفَضَّلْ / تَفَضَّلِي and أَحْسَنْتَ / أَحْسَنْتِ for Sami and Salma; then the hub card and print-book.sh. Start the art only after the Salma redraw.
ceo_note: This is the step from a demo to a curriculum, but 'finish before starting': fix and print lesson 1 first.

title: Sentence-builder game under a picture
detail: The child taps tiles [هَذَا | هَذِهِ] + noun + optional [صَغِيرٌ | صَغِيرَةٌ], and Noori reads the sentence back. A wrong tile gives shake + hint. It fills the 'build' step between choosing and writing, using existing pictures.
ceo_note: Strong interaction, but new code. It comes after the echo and the clips make the existing screens speak.

title: Digital "two baskets" sort with the fence words mixed in
detail: Picture cards go into a هَذَا basket or a هَذِهِ basket, with بِنْتٌ / أُمٌّ / شَمْسٌ mixed in. Tries are unlimited and there is no score. This is the deck's variant made playable, and it suits children who cannot trace yet.
ceo_note: Two roles proposed it. Keep it after the sentence builder; only one new game at a time.

title: Listening game: Noori says a word, the child taps هَذَا or هَذِهِ
detail: Reuse the word clips and the quiz component; no new motion.
ceo_note: Cheap once the clips exist; it depends on the 'next' clip item.

title: Adab-phrase stickers as the end-of-lesson reward
detail: Pair each existing Noori pose with a phrase the child can use today (salam, شُكْرًا, مِنْ فَضْلِكَ, بِسْمِ اللَّهِ before eating, الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ). They are phrases to say, never a game mechanic or a wrong option.
ceo_note: Lives adab, but it is a new reward system. Do it after the lived-values story text.

title: Beach clean-up page for the next book
detail: Noori and the children pick up litter: new nouns for هَذَا / هَذِهِ and care for creation, lived. Draw a plain water bottle (NEG already has "bottles").
ceo_note: A good candidate value for book 2 rather than a page added to book 1.

title: A pre-reader start screen with three picture buttons
detail: kids.html: story · book · write as huge picture buttons, with Noori saying each choice aloud on tap, so a five-year-old can start without reading.
ceo_note: Pairs with the KG cut; there is little to start from until that exists.

title: Brand sheet once the owners pick a logo and a theme
detail: One page in logos/index.html: the chosen logo, wordmark, the 6 swatches with their text twins, and Noori dos and don'ts.
ceo_note: Waits on the owners' logo and theme decision.

title: A cast sheet: Noori, Sami and Salma side by side
detail: Make one reference image at one size, front-on, in assets/art/source/, and have the topic-book skill copy it for every future book.
ceo_note: Draw it right after the Salma redraw so the reference is the corrected Salma.

title: One Friday-night teacher pack PDF
detail: Put the 11 worksheets, the answers page and a QR cover sheet into one Letter file.
ceo_note: Less work for teachers, but no teacher has asked yet. After the proof.

title: A printable A5 masjid flyer
detail: Noori, the schedule and a QR code to the parents page, for the masjid noticeboard where San Diego families find weekend schools.
ceo_note: Needs the real details from the owners and the parents page first.

title: A short accessibility statement for parents
detail: One plain-English paragraph in the parents' section and the footer: listen buttons, big text, and how to report a problem.
ceo_note: Builds trust for families with additional needs. Put it on the parents page when that exists.
